title: Concrete pair categories and strict coefficients
statement: Given a preorder I, categories C_i, normalized transition functors U_ij and coherent gamma, form Obj_i = {(s,h,X) | s ≤ i, X in C_s} and homs between their U_si-images. Evaluation and the current-stage inclusion are equivalences. Transition fixes (s,X) and conjugates U_ij on homs by gamma. The normalization and gamma cocycle give a strict diagram F. For coefficients v_i with normalized coherent delta, define v′_i(s,X)=v_s X and conjugate v_i on homs by delta. Then transition composed with v′_j equals v′_i, inclusion composed with v′_i equals v_i, and applying v′_j to the explicit comparison theta gives delta inverse, including endpoints in Arrow.

proof.text: Define induced categories on stage-labelled objects. Naturality proves the conjugation formulas are functorial. Use the gamma cocycle at both endpoints, and its naturality between them, for strict composition. Normalized comparisons prove identities. Evaluation is induced fully faithful and every object occurs at its own stage, giving equivalences. Apply the same cancellation argument using delta to prove strict coefficient composition; normalization gives inclusion equality and the theta Arrow equality. Every object and map is explicitly defined.

proof_origin.place: W4: original explicit pair construction generalized to independent index, object, and hom universes; the old small specialization is unchanged.
